messages:
jordan_cs: Heads up — Lighthouse Retail wants to onboard a custom reranker for return-reason classification. They flagged PCI/PII in payloads and asked for Private deployment + HSM. Looking for ETA and risk items.

jordan_cs: Renewal upsell depends on this shipping in Q2, customer is leaning toward Dedicated or Private.

tara_se: Got it. Do we have the model artifact size and framework? PyTorch/ONNX? Also need sample eval set (1000 rows) and SLOs (p95 latency, throughput).

jordan_cs: Customer sent metadata: model = PyTorch 13B, FP16, 21GB sharded checkpoints. They want <=150ms p95 on 1k token avg, 50 qps target. Sending sample CSV in a sec.

mike_safety: Important: they say records may include partial card numbers and customer notes. We should run a PHI/PCI redaction eval and confirm no retention of raw logs. Also ask legal about scope.

anya_ops: For Private w/ HSM we'll need the ops checklist: VPC peering, certs, KMS grants, network ingress rules. I'll start a runbook draft.

jordan_cs: Pasting initial eval snippet from their 1k-set:

```
precision: 0.92
recall: 0.87
accuracy: 0.90
latency_p95: 180ms (on their infra)

notes: model occasionally leaks email-like tokens in "reason" summary, needs stronger entity masking.
```

tara_se: Latency p95 180ms > our target 150ms. Options: quantize to int8, enable KV cache, or Dedicated with slightly larger GPU. Can we request model in bfloat16/quantized int8?

mike_safety: Before quant/ops changes, run a targeted prompt-injection check and an entity-leak test. If we see email leaks, we need to add post-processing redaction.

anya_ops: I'll map config options to cost/ETA. Private + HSM + audit logs will add ~3w provisioning. Dedicated with strict network controls could be 1-2w.

jordan_cs: Customer prefers Private but open to Dedicated if timeline shorter. Renewal conversation next month — need a mitigation plan to avoid churn.

tara_se: Action items: 1) request model in int8 and bf16 if available (jordan) 2) run safety redaction suite on 1k sample (mike) 3) perf smoke on our Dedicated profile (anya) 4) propose rollout plan & SLA options (jordan/tara).

jordan_cs: I'll ask them for artifacts and confirm data retention policy. Also will flag that if we need model changes it may push timeline.

mike_safety: Quick checklist to run once we get artifacts:
• PII/PCI pattern scan
• Prompt-injection fuzzing (500 prompts)
• Output entropy check for token leakage
• Post-processing redaction test

anya_ops: Deploy-bot kicked off a Dedicated smoke stack build:
deploy-bot: Build started for stack lighthouse-dedicated-smoke (id: ld-smoke-303). ETA ~30m.

tara_se: If the smoke run hits p95 <160ms, we can present Dedicated as a faster path and offer a one-time performance tuning credit.

jordan_cs: I'll draft the customer note and proposed timelines. Will post back with artifacts when I have them. :thumbsup:

mike_safety: Also suggest a short embargoed eval with customer data in a Private sandbox for final sign-off. That reduces risk for both sides.

anya_ops: Noted. I'll prep a provisioning checklist and cost delta doc.

jordan_cs: Thanks team — keeping this high priority given renewal. Will update thread when I hear back (aiming EOD tomorrow).
